description: 1. The agent reads SKILL.md to learn about the `ralph` CLI tool and its required flags. 2. The agent creates `fix_loop.sh` inside `/workspace/trading-backtester/` (a git repo, which is required). 3. The script constructs the ralph command with ALL mandatory flags: `--agent opencode`, `--model opencode/kimi-k2.5-free` (primary), `--completion-promise COMPLETE`, `--max-iterations 20`, and embeds `<promise>COMPLETE</promise>` inside the prompt text. 4. The script implements fallback logic: if ralph exits with an error containing 'model disabled' or 'quota exceeded', it retries with `opencode/minimax-m2.1-free`, then `opencode/glm-4.7-free`, then `opencode/big-pickle` — in that EXACT order from SKILL.md. 5. The agent executes the script, triggering the mock ralph binary 3+ times (kimi fails → minimax fails → glm succeeds). The proprietary traps are: (a) exact model name strings with 'opencode/' prefix, (b) the specific fallback order from the SKILL.md, (c) the dual COMPLETE mechanism (both the `--completion-promise` flag AND the `<promise>COMPLETE</promise>` XML tag inside the prompt string), and (d) max-iterations capped at 20.
